## 1. Verdict
Genuine fuzz corpus member: byte-exact equal to `canonical/out2.srt` except offset 112, which
is `0xBE = '>' (0x3E) XOR 0x80` (python3: `equal-except-112: True, xor112: 0x80`). The flip
destroys the SECOND '>' of cue 3's `-->` arrow, so the last block ("3 / 00:01:02,030 --¾
00:01:02,050 / Quick flash cue") contains no arrow at all. Parsed by me through the real
parser (probe_srt): the whole third block is skipped as `GarbageBlock @line 9` (typed
damage), cues 1–2 survive clean ([1_000_000, 4_000_000] and [5_500_000, 9_250_000] µs),
Windows-1252 fallback recorded. Correct resync-to-block-boundary behavior, no panic.
